name: Melchisedec
summary: The king of Salem and a priest of the most high God, who met Abram with bread and wine and blessed him. Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

key_moments.title: Bread and Wine for Abram
key_moments.description: When Abram came back from defeating the kings, Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine and blessed him by the most high God. Abram gave him a tenth of all he had.

key_moments.title: A Priest Forever
key_moments.description: In a psalm, the LORD swears an oath He will not take back, naming someone a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

key_moments.title: Like the Son of God
key_moments.description: Hebrews says his name means King of righteousness, and that as King of Salem he was King of peace. It describes him as without father, mother or family line, made like the Son of God, a priest who remains for all time.
